relations.support_notes:
A note in two parts has been added to the title on the cover page of instance (ID:5492) of this work. We take the mention of "bsam bzang pa'i" above the title to refer to the author of the work, and the mention of "rgyal sras 'jigs med kyi dpe'o" below to indicate ownership.
The author post-dates mChims nam mkha' grags (ID:3977) and mChims Blo bzang grags pa (ID:4007), who are mentioned at the beginning of the work.
